new_destinations.name: Quzhou
new_destinations.coordinates_source: OSM place=city relation (Quzhou); city centre point
new_destinations.name_evidence: China Daily Quzhou government tourism pages use 'Quzhou' as the heading for its ancient city, Confucius South Family Temple and Lanke Mountain; English Wikipedia 'Quzhou' (~18k views/yr); Wikivoyage Zhejiang lists it as a city. Wikivoyage has no own Quzhou page (judge note).
new_destinations.reason: Prefecture-level city and regional hub with seven kept spots in and around it; rank 4 (worth a detour, not a national top-tier draw).

new_destinations.name: Jiangshan
new_destinations.coordinates_source: Centre between Mount Jianglang (OSM peak) and its village/pass cluster; not from memory of a town centre
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Jiangshan' page and the Wikivoyage Zhejiang region page (counted); China Daily gov Jiangshan one-day itinerary listing Jianglang Mountain, Nianbadu, Qingyang and Xianxia Pass. Named for the county-level city which travellers use as the base for Jianglang Mountain.
new_destinations.reason: Four kept spots around the Jiangshan base (Mount Jianglang, Nianbadu, Qingyang Village, Xianxia Pass); the town Jiangshan itself is the gateway, not a separate spot beside its own attractions.

spots.name: Quzhou Ancient City
spots.bio: Walled old town of Quzhou around the riverside Shuiting Gate, with the Three Streets and Seven Alleys lanes to wander.
spots.reason: Kept spot of Quzhou: old town inside the city; also absorbs the Quzhou City Wall candidate (one spot at Shuiting Gate).

spots.name: Confucius South Family Temple
spots.bio: Ancestral temple of the southern branch of Confucius's descendants, set in Quzhou's old town.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 1494317479 (孔氏南宗家庙, historic=building)
spots.reason: Kept spot: inside Quzhou's urban area.

spots.name: Lanke Mountain
spots.bio: Mountain tied to a Go (weiqi) legend, with a natural stone bridge, Baoyan Temple and a Go park.
spots.reason: Kept spot: about 10 km from the city centre, in Quzhou's greater metro.

spots.name: Yaowang Mountain
spots.bio: Scenic area with Shennong Gully, a stone forest and the 88 m Mawei Waterfall.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node 5430941057 (药王山入口, visitor entrance)
spots.reason: Kept spot: about 22 km south-east of Quzhou, within the 50 km span.

spots.name: Tianji Longmen Gorge
spots.bio: Scenic area of canyons, peaks and waterfalls next to Yaowang Mountain.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node 5430674504 (天脊龙门, tourism=attraction; a second node 6565624050 sits 2 km away)
spots.reason: Kept spot: about 28 km south-east of Quzhou, within span (75% of 50 km).

spots.name: Mawei Waterfall
spots.bio: An 88 m waterfall described as Quzhou's most famous, inside the Yaowang Mountain scenic area.
spots.reason: Kept spot; sits inside Yaowang Mountain's area (judge flagged possible overlap, kept as a distinct named sight).
spots.pin_note: Skeptic: may be treated as part of Yaowang Mountain.

spots.name: Duze Old Street
spots.bio: Restored 820 m Qing-dynasty street with blacksmith and bamboo-weaving craft shops.
spots.reason: Kept spot, added by judge; in Kecheng District; confirm it lies within Quzhou's bounds when pinned.

spots.name: Mount Jianglang
spots.bio: Red-sandstone peak trio near Jiangshan, a UNESCO-listed China Danxia site with a stairway up the central rock.
spots.reason: Kept spot: headline of the Jiangshan destination.

spots.name: Nianbadu
spots.bio: Ming-Qing ancient town in southern Jiangshan, rated 5A, with old streets and a river setting.
spots.reason: Kept spot: about 25 km from Jianglang, within Jiangshan's span; a place of its own.

spots.name: Qingyang Village
spots.bio: Mao-clan ancestral village near Jianglang Mountain with an ancestral house and a tower.
spots.reason: Kept spot: 5 km from Mount Jianglang.

spots.name: Xianxia Pass
spots.bio: Ancient Zhejiang-Fujian road and mountain pass, a heritage trail on a Jiangshan one-day itinerary.
spots.reason: Kept spot, limited scale; pin must be sourced and confirmed inside Jiangshan's span.
spots.pin_note: Trail: pin at midpoint of route.

spots.name: Gengong Buddhist Kingdom
spots.bio: Root-carving cultural park in Kaihua, home to the world's largest root statue of Sakyamuni.
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 759949402 (根宫佛国文化旅游区, leisure=park)
spots.reason: Standalone: Kaihua has only two kept places (this and Qicai Changhong), under the four-spot bar; Kaihua is not a destination travellers name for a trip. >40 km from Quzhou's centre (about 50 km), outside its bounds.

spots.name: Qianjiangyuan National Park
spots.bio: National park protecting the headwaters of the Qiantang River, with primeval forest and rich wildlife in Kaihua.
spots.reason: Standalone: a national park is a destination only with four spots or flagship rank; only Qicai Changhong is kept inside (Gutianshan and the Forest Park entry are review/duplicates, one entry placed). Candidate point is a relation centroid.
spots.pin_note: Candidate point (29.31043, 118.2114) is a relation centroid; needs a visitor point (visitor centre or main entrance).

spots.name: Qicai Changhong Scenic Area
spots.bio: Mountain scenic area in Kaihua's national park zone, with Taihui Mountain and the Gaotiankeng stargazing village.
spots.reason: Standalone: inside Qianjiangyuan's zone but the park is a standalone spot, which cannot hold spots; 35 km from Kaihua.

spots.name: Longyou Caves
spots.bio: Man-made grottoes carved in sandstone about 2,000 years ago; 36 chambers open to visitors in Longyou County.
spots.reason: Standalone: ~45 km east of Quzhou centre, outside its bounds; Longyou has no other kept spots.

spots.name: Sanqu Stone Forest
spots.bio: 4A national geology park of karst stone pillars within Changshan UNESCO Global Geopark.
spots.reason: Standalone: Changshan County, ~35 km west of Quzhou, outside the city's bounds. Judge noted possible renovation closure; verify.

spots.name: Changshan Geopark
spots.bio: UNESCO Global Geopark of 1,043 sq km around Changshan with dispersed geological sites.
spots.reason: Standalone: large dispersed area in Changshan County, placed at its main visitor point; outside Quzhou's bounds. Overlaps Sanqu Stone Forest (kept separately as a distinct 4A site).

spots.name: Jiming Mountain Folk Houses
spots.bio: Minju Garden of 34 relocated ancient buildings, a provincial key relic.
spots.reason: Standalone: location unconfirmed (pin needed); no destination known to hold it.

spots.name: Taoyuan Qili Scenic Area
spots.bio: Largest national 4A rural-leisure scenic area in Zhejiang with waterfalls, a stone forest and ancient villages.
spots.reason: Standalone: large rural area, placed at its main visitor point once pinned; bounds against Quzhou unconfirmed so not a Quzhou spot.

review.case_against: For: city-side leisure island. Against: one-sentence source, details unverified.

notes: Quzhou City Wall merged into Quzhou Ancient City. Jiangshan town is the destination, not a separate spot. Qianjiangyuan National Forest Park and Gutianshan are in review; one park entry placed. Standalone spots within 40 km of Quzhou's centre: Sanqu Stone Forest (~35 km) and Longyou Caves (~45 km) lie in other counties outside its bounds. Standalone spots within 40 km of Jiangshan centre: none.
